# Don't Cook Don't Clean

> Verified domestic helper placement service in Patna, Bihar, India — maids, cooks, babysitters, and elder-care helpers, background-checked and matched to households within 24-48 hours.

Don't Cook Don't Clean connects families across Patna with ID-verified, reference-checked domestic helpers. Every helper goes through identity verification and background checks before being recommended to a household; live-in, childcare, and elder-care placements also go through police verification. The service covers part-time, full-time, and live-in arrangements for cooking, cleaning, babysitting, and elder care.

Contact: +91-88771-94682 (call or WhatsApp) · info@dontcookdontclean.in
